scenarios.theme: Time partitioning permits duplicate IDs in different months. How will you keep global identity?
scenarios.assumptions: An ingestion API requires event_id to identify exactly one event regardless of timestamp. A partitioned primary key on event_id/recorded_at accepts duplicate IDs in different months. What will you do?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

scenarios.theme: A one-day report scans every monthly partition. What will you inspect?

scenarios.theme: All writes hit the newest partition. Why did monthly partitioning not scale writes across machines?
scenarios.assumptions: An append-heavy service partitions by month on one PostgreSQL server. The newest child and shared I/O are saturated. More old partitions are added but throughput does not improve. What will you do?
